ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for sequential logic. Drives the two clocked processes that update lock_q bits and the bus response outputs.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in spinlock process and bus_response process to update lock_q and bus_rsp_o.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronous reset that forces initial values on registers. It overrides normal assignments to lock_q and bus_rsp_o when asserted low and appears in both processes' reset branches.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then branches in spinlock and bus_response processes assign lock_q and bus_rsp_o (reset behavior).

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Bundle carrying bus request fields. Its fields (stb, addr, rw) drive lock updates, select which lock index is targeted, and control response data and ack generation.
role: CARRIES address, strobe, and read/write control
ports.evidence: fields of bus_req_i (stb, addr, rw) are used in sel generation, spinlock update condition, and bus_response process to form ack and data.

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides address bits used to select which lock index (addr(6 downto 2)) and to choose masked versus full read (addr(7)). Governs sel generation and response-data selection.
ports.evidence: used as addr(6 downto 2) in sel generation and addr(7) in if conditions for lock update and response data selection.

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Declared request data field that is not referenced in this source. No logic reads or writes this field here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences beyond declaration; bus_req_i.data never appears in this file.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared byte-enable field that is not read or used anywhere in this entity's source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences beyond declaration; bus_req_i.ben not referenced in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Strobe that indicates a valid bus request. It gates lock updates and response data generation and is forwarded into the response ack output.
role: GATES lock update and response generation
ports.evidence: Used in conditions (if bus_req_i.stb = '1') to gate lock_q update and bus_rsp_o.data; assigned to bus_rsp_o.ack in bus_response process.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Indicates read or write and both gates response-data logic and supplies the value captured into a lock bit (captured as inverted).
ports.evidence: Used as RHS in lock_q(i) <= not bus_req_i.rw and in condition if bus_req_i.rw = '0' for response data.

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared source field of the request record that is not referenced in this source file.
ports.evidence: No occurrences beyond declaration; bus_req_i.src not used.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared privilege flag in the request record but not read or used by this entity.
ports.evidence: No references in source; only declared.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared debug flag not used anywhere in this entity's implementation.
ports.evidence: No occurrences beyond declaration in the provided source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared AMO flag that is not referenced in this source; no AMO handling is implemented here.
ports.evidence: Only declared; not used in any assignment or condition in this entity.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared AMO operation field that is not read or used by this entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrences beyond declaration in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared lock modifier bit in the request bundle that is not used in this source.
ports.evidence: Not referenced anywhere in the entity implementation.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared fence field in the request that is not used by this entity's logic.
ports.evidence: Only present in declaration; no uses found in source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Output bundle carrying ack, err, and data fields back to the bus. The bundle is assigned at reset and updated on clock edges from lock_q, sel and bus_req_i.stb.
role: EXPORTS lock and status to external bus
ports.evidence: bus_response process assigns bus_rsp_o at reset and updates its fields at rising_edge(clk_i) using lock_q, sel, and bus_req_i.stb.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: At each rising clock edge sets ack to the incoming request strobe (bus_req_i.stb), reporting request reception to the bus.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside bus_response process at rising_edge(clk_i).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Error output forced to '0' on each clocked update in this entity; it does not reflect any computed condition from declared elements.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' assigned in bus_response process (rising_edge branch); reset assigns bus_rsp_o whole record to rsp_terminate_c.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Provides 32-bit response data to the bus. On reads it derives from lock_q (optionally masked by sel), otherwise defaults to zero; updated at clock edges and reset assigned to rsp_terminate_c.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data <= lock_q and sel or <= lock_q in bus_response process when bus_req_i.stb='1' and bus_req_i.rw='0'; default assigned (others=>'0').

signals.name: lock_q
signals.functionality: Holds one bit per spinlock, reset to '0' and updated on matching bus requests. Each bit lock_q(i) captures the inverted bus_req_i.rw when stb, addr(7)='0' and sel(i)='1'.
signals.evidence: spinlock process: lock_q(i) <= '0' on rstn_i='0'; on rising_edge(clk_i) lock_q(i) <= not bus_req_i.rw when stb and addr(7)='0' and sel(i)='1'.

signals.name: sel
signals.functionality: Combinational one-hot vector derived from bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2). Sel(i) is '1' when the address field equals index i; used to target a single lock bit for updates and masked reads.
signals.evidence: Concurrent assignment sel(i) <= '1' when bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2) = to_unsigned(i) else '0'; sel(i) used in spinlock update condition and in bus_rsp_o.data <= lock_q and sel.
